summary: No public repository dataset pairs Artemia abdomen and cephalothorax lengths with rearing or habitat salinity; Dryad and Zenodo hold Artemia genetics, parasite, taphonomy and salinity-survival tables, GBIF holds 6,233 occurrences without measurements, and the classic morphometric series (Schmankewitsch 1875, Gilchrist 1960, Amat 1980s, Triantaphyllidis et al. 1997) remain in paper tables.
next_step: Digitize the per-salinity morphometric tables from the Artemia literature (e.g. Triantaphyllidis et al. 1997 'International study on Artemia' and Amat's Spanish population series) into one table with salinity, population, sex and abdomen/cephalothorax lengths, or rear one population across a salinity series and measure.
obstacles_confirmed: Morphometrics sit in paper tables rather than one open archive.
Morphometric data paired with exact salinity are scattered.
